name: Spatial Awareness
text:
Your study of different planes of existence makes you more attuned to teleportation effects. You gain a +1 circumstance bonus when you attempt to counteract a teleportation effect.

When a teleportation effect occurs within 60 feet of you, you detect the location of the effect as a precise sense. If the effect is a creature teleporting away from that space, you know the general direction of the location to which it teleported but not the distance. However, you can attempt to Identify Magic within an hour of the teleportation to know the location to which the creature teleported within 10 miles on a success or 1 mile on a critical success.
